people.name: House_of_the_Forest
people.line: A building in Solomon's palace complex

translations.web: He took away the covering of Judah; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.
translations.bsb: He has uncovered the defenses of Judah. On that day you looked to the weapons in the House of the Forest.
translations.kjv: And he discovered the covering of Judah, and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest.
translations.asv: And he took away the covering of Judah; and thou didst look in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.
